import json,sys,subprocess,tempfile,zipfile,pathlib,hashlib,importlib,importlib.metadata
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
 package=pathlib.Path(temp)/'package';zipfile.ZipFile('/input/agent.zip').extractall(package)
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','--no-cache-dir',str(package)],check=True)
 from caeoj.sdk import load_problem,load_result
 from caeoj.validation import ContractError
 from caeoj import runtime
 task=pathlib.Path('/task');rows=[]
 for p in sorted((task/'cases').glob('*/problem.json')):
  problem=load_problem(p);load_result(problem,task/'reference'/p.parent.name/'reference.h5')
  rows.append(p.parent.name)
 for p in sorted((task/'samples').glob('*/input/problem.json')):
  problem=load_problem(p);load_result(problem,p.parent.parent/'output/result.h5')
 sample=next((task/'samples').glob('*/input/problem.json'))
 import shutil
 variant=pathlib.Path(temp)/'variant';shutil.copytree(sample.parent,variant)
 meta=json.loads((variant/'problem.json').read_text());meta['physics']['parameters']['iterations']['value']=float(meta['physics']['parameters']['iterations']['value']);(variant/'problem.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta))
 try:load_problem(variant/'problem.json')
 except ContractError as error:
  assert 'JSON integer' in str(error.report),error.report
 else:raise AssertionError('Installed SDK accepted float iterations')
 module=importlib.import_module('caeoj_task_ext.'+'wall_energy')
 print('OFFLINE_RESULT='+json.dumps({'passed':True,'cases':rows,'samples':2,'iterations_float_rejected':True,'package_version':importlib.metadata.version('cae-bench-oj'),'runtime':runtime.bundle_info(),'installed_checker':module.__file__,'installed_checker_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(module.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
